info.name: Story Spark AI — Complete API
info.description:
## Story Spark AI — Complete API Collection

Complete, ready-to-run Postman collection covering **every backend route** of Story Spark AI (frontend + server).

### Base URL
| Environment | Value |
|---|---|
| Local Backend | `http://localhost:5000` |
| API Prefix | `/api/v1` |

### Authentication Flow (run in this order)
1. **OTP Validation → Verify Email** — sends an OTP to the mailbox.
2. **OTP Validation → Verify OTP** — returns a `verificationToken` (auto-saved to `{{verification_token}}`).
3. **Auth → Register** — uses the verification token. Returns `accessToken` (auto-saved).
4. **Auth → Login** — returns `accessToken` (auto-saved to `{{access_token}}`).
5. All protected requests automatically use `{{access_token}}`.

### Auth Header Format
The backend reads the JWT **directly** from the `Authorization` header — **no `Bearer ` prefix**:
```
Authorization: eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIs...
```

### Roles
`user`, `writer`, `admin`, `super_admin` — role-protected routes are marked in each request description.

### Response Envelope
Most endpoints return:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "message": "...",
  "meta": { "page": 1, "limit": 10, "total": 100 },
  "data": { }
}
```

item.name: 01 Auth
item.description:
Authentication module — login, register, Google OAuth, refresh tokens and password management.

Mount: `/api/v1/auth`

body.raw:
{
  "email": "{{test_email}}",
  "name": "{{test_name}}",
  "password": "{{test_password}}",
  "confirmPassword": "{{test_password}}",
  "verificationToken": "{{verification_token}}"
}

request.description: Register a new user. Password needs 8+ chars, upper, lower, number and special char. `verificationToken` comes from **Verify OTP**. Sets refresh-token cookie and returns `accessToken`.
Login with email + password. Rate limited. Returns `accessToken`; refresh token is set as an httpOnly cookie.

exec: console.log('access_token saved — protected routes are now ready to run');

request.description: Exchange a Google OAuth ID token for a Story Spark session.

header.description: Send the refresh token raw in the Authorization header

request.description: Rotate an expired access token. Pass the refresh token (raw) in the `Authorization` header.
Change the logged-in user's password. Auth required (any role). Invalidates previous sessions.
Send a password-reset OTP to the given email. Rate limited.
Reset the password using the OTP verification token received from the forgot-password flow.

item.name: 02 OTP Validation (Verify Email)
item.description:
Email verification + OTP issuing before registration.

Mount: `/api/v1/otp_validation`

request.description: Sends a 6-digit OTP to the email. Run this before Verify OTP.
Validates the OTP and returns a `verificationToken` used by **Register** / **Reset Password**. Max 5 failed attempts per OTP.

item.name: 03 User
item.description:
User profile, admin user management, writer applications and follow system.

Mount: `/api/v1/user`

request.description: Full user list. **Roles:** admin, super_admin.
Profile of the authenticated user (reads JWT from Authorization header).
All users who applied for the writer role. **Roles:** admin, super_admin.
Fetch one user by Mongo `_id`. Auth required (any role).
Update the authenticated user's name / avatar / bio / social links. All fields optional.
Delete a user account. **Roles:** admin, super_admin.
Mark the current user as a writer applicant. **Role:** user.
Promote an applicant to writer by email. **Roles:** admin, super_admin.
Toggles follow state for the given author id. Auth required.
Returns whether the authenticated user follows the given author.

item.name: 04 AI Model
item.description:
AI story generation endpoints — premium (quota monitored) and free (rate limited) variants, streaming, alternate endings, remix and translate.

Tone enum: `Dark`, `Humorous`, `Romantic`, `Epic`, `Mysterious`, `Children's`
Remix types: `setting`, `perspective`, `time_period`, `tone`, `gender_swap`

Mount: `/api/v1/ai_model`

body.raw:
{
  "prompt": "A lighthouse keeper discovers a message in a bottle from the future",
  "wordLength": 250,
  "numStories": 2,
  "language": "English",
  "tone": "Mysterious"
}

request.description: Generate multiple story variations with Gemini/OpenAI. Consumes the user's monthly request quota.

body.raw:
{
  "prompt": "A robot barista gains consciousness during the morning rush",
  "wordLength": 200,
  "numStories": 1,
  "language": "English",
  "tone": "Humorous"
}

request.description: Free-tier generation, no login or quota required. IP rate limited.
Server-Sent Events stream (`text/event-stream`). Chunks arrive as `data: {"chunk": "..."}` and end with `data: {"done": true}`.
Generate alternate endings for an existing story. Requires `title`, `content`, `tag`.
Free alternate endings, no auth. IP rate limited.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "The Lighthouse Signal",
  "content": "The keeper lit the lamp one last time...",
  "tag": "Mystery",
  "remixType": "setting",
  "remixOption": "underwater city",
  "language": "English"
}

request.description: Remix a story by `setting`, `perspective`, `time_period`, `tone` or `gender_swap`.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "The Lighthouse Signal",
  "content": "The keeper lit the lamp...",
  "tag": "Mystery",
  "remixType": "tone",
  "remixOption": "Dark"
}

request.description: Free remix, no auth. IP rate limited.
Translate a story into `targetLanguage`.
Free translation, no auth. IP rate limited.

item.name: 05 Posts
item.description:
Story posts — publish, browse, feature, bookmark, remix and translate published stories.

Mount: `/api/v1/post`

request.description: Publish a story post. `title` min 3 chars, `content` min 10 chars, `imageURL` must be a valid URL, at least 2 topics. Auth required.
Public paginated post feed with filters and search.
Most recent published posts (public).
Editor's featured posts (public).
Toggle the featured flag on a post. Auth required.

query.description: Optional: exclude this related post id

request.description: Fetch one post by id (public).
All published posts under a tag (public).
Add/remove the post from the user's bookmarks. Auth required.
Update a post. Auth required (author or admin roles).
Soft-delete a post. Auth required.
AI-remix an existing published story. Auth required, quota monitored.
Translate a published story to another language. Auth required.

item.name: 06 Comments
item.description:
Comments on posts with threading and likes.

Mount: `/api/v1/comment`

request.description: Comment on a post. Add `parentCommentId` to reply in a thread. Auth required.
All comments (with replies) for a post. Public.
Like/unlike a comment. Note the unusual path format `commentId=<id>`. Auth required.

item.name: 07 Reviews
item.description:
Site testimonials — public listing, user submission, admin moderation.

Mount: `/api/v1/review`

request.description: Public list of approved reviews.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Demo Writer",
  "role": "Storyteller",
  "feedback": "Story Spark AI turned my one-line idea into a full world. The remix tool is pure magic!",
  "imgSrc": "https://i.pravatar.cc/150?img=12",
  "rating": 5
}

request.description: Submit a testimonial. `feedback` min 10 chars, `imgSrc` required, `rating` 1–5 optional. Creates a pending review.
Reviews awaiting approval. **Roles:** admin, super_admin.
Approve a pending review so it appears publicly. **Roles:** admin, super_admin.

item.name: 08 Reactions
item.description:
Post reactions (likes/emoji).

Mount: `/api/v1/reaction`

request.description: Toggle a reaction on a post. Returns the updated `likesCount`. Auth required.

item.name: 09 Notifications
item.description:
Realtime-backed user notifications (Socket.IO room `user:<id>`).

Mount: `/api/v1/notifications`

request.description: Notifications for the authenticated user. Auth required.
Mark one notification as read. Auth required.

item.name: 10 Bookmarks
item.description:
Dedicated bookmark module for saved stories.

Mount: `/api/v1/bookmarks`

request.description: Add or remove a story bookmark. Auth required.
All bookmarked stories of the current user. Auth required.
Is the given story bookmarked by the current user? Auth required.
Remove a bookmark directly. Auth required.

item.name: 11 Story Versions
item.description:
Version history for stories — snapshots, restore, and AI prompt enhancement.

Mount: `/api/v1/story`

request.description: All saved versions of a story. Auth required.
One version snapshot. Auth required.
Restore a story to the given snapshot. Auth required.
AI-enhance a story prompt. `prompt` min 3 chars. Auth required.

item.name: 12 Story Branching
item.description:
Branch a story from a selected choice.

Mount: `/api/v1/stories`

request.description: Generate the next branch from `storyContext` + `selectedChoice`. `storyContext` max 8000 chars. Auth required.

item.name: 13 Story Continuation
item.description:
Continue an existing story with AI.

Mount: `/api/v1/story-continuation`

request.description: Generate a continuation chapter from the given prompt. Returns `{ text }`.

item.name: 14 Story Inspiration
item.description:
Get AI sparks for story ideas from an intro line.

Mount: `/api/v1/story-inspiration`

request.description: Generate idea sparks from an intro. `intro` required, max 1000 chars. Public.

item.name: 15 Analytics
item.description:
Platform/writer analytics widgets. First four endpoints work with or without a token; the last three require auth.

Mount: `/api/v1/analytics`

request.description: Headline metrics (stories, posts, totals). Token optional.
Activity heatmap data. Token optional.
Genre distribution for charts. Token optional.
Word cloud data. Token optional.
Most productive writing hours. Auth required.
Emotion analysis across stories. Auth required.
Mood over time. Auth required.

item.name: 16 Analysis
item.description:
Dashboard analysis endpoint.

Mount: `/api/v1/analysis`

request.description: Aggregated dashboard analysis for the user. Auth required.

item.name: 17 Recommendations
item.description:
Personalized story recommendations.

Mount: `/api/v1/recommendations`

request.description: Stories recommended for the current user based on their activity. Auth required.

item.name: 18 Newsletter
item.description:
Newsletter subscribe / verify / unsubscribe.

Mount: `/api/v1/newsletter`

request.description: Subscribe an email. Duplicate emails return 409.
Confirm a subscription with the token emailed to the subscriber.
Unsubscribe directly by email.
Generate a one-click unsubscribe token for an email.
One-click unsubscribe via emailed token link.

item.name: 19 Contact
item.description:
Contact / feedback form.

feedbackType: `bug-report`, `feature-request`, `general-feedback`

Mount: `/api/v1/contact`

body.raw:
{
  "fullname": "Demo Writer",
  "email": "demo@storyspark.ai",
  "feedbackType": "feature-request",
  "subject": "Collaborative writing rooms",
  "message": "It would be amazing to co-write stories in real time with friends."
}

request.description: Public contact form. `subject` and `message` required; `fullname`/`email` optional.

item.name: 20 Reports
item.description:
Content moderation reports.

targetType: `POST`, `COMMENT`
reason: `SPAM`, `HATE_SPEECH`, `INAPPROPRIATE`, `MISINFORMATION`, `OTHER`

Mount: `/api/v1/reports`

request.description: Report a post or comment. Auth required.
Moderation queue. **Roles:** admin, super_admin.

item.name: 21 Bug Reports
item.description:
Public bug report submission (also creates a GitHub issue server-side).

Mount: `/api/v1/bug-reports`

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Story editor loses draft on refresh",
  "category": "Editor",
  "severity": "High",
  "description": "Draft text disappears when the page reloads before saving.",
  "steps": "1. Type a story\n2. Refresh the page\n3. Draft is gone",
  "expected": "Draft should persist locally until saved.",
  "actual": "Draft is cleared on refresh.",
  "email": "demo@storyspark.ai"
}

request.description: Submit a structured bug report. All fields required except `email`.

item.name: 22 Writer Applications
item.description:
Writer application pipeline — submit (user), review + approve/reject (admin).

Mount: `/api/v1/writer-applications`

request.description: Submit a writer application. `portfolioLink` must be a valid URL, `reason` min 10 chars. **Role:** user.
All submitted applications. **Roles:** admin, super_admin.
Approve or reject an application. `status`: `approved` | `rejected`. **Roles:** admin, super_admin.

item.name: 23 Payment
item.description:
Razorpay checkout — create order and verify signature.

Mount: `/api/v1/payment`

request.description: Create a Razorpay order. `amount` in INR (number, > 0). Auth required. Save `order.id` into `{{order_id}}` for the verify step.
Verify the Razorpay HMAC-SHA256 signature (`order_id|payment_id`). Auth required. Signature mismatch returns 400.

item.name: 24 Sanity Checks
item.description: Quick health-style checks for the API surface itself.

request.description: Any unknown route must return the global 404 envelope: `success: false`, `message: "Not Found"`, `errorMessage[].message: "API Not Found"`.
Protected route without a token must return 401 `You are not authorized to access`.
